items.description:
Open data dataset published on Open Data NI (opendatani.gov.uk) by Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs, licensed UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Catalogue reference record; the data is served from Open Data NI.

About this layer

Network contribution area scores were exported from the SciMAP application outputs within SAGA GIS. The scores were based on inputs from CEH Land cover 2007, Met Office average rainfall and 5 meter DTM. The High contribution category boundary was determined by selecting +1 standard deviation of the distribution of the scores.

Catalogue reference record; the data is served from Open Data NI. Orthophotography is aerial imagery that has been geometrically corrected. An orthophoto is an image that is free of distortion, and which is characterised by a uniform scale over its entire surface - it has been ortho-rectified.

Orthophotography was captured as part of the 2021 NI 3D Coastal Survey. Coverage extends across the entire Northern Ireland coastline, including the intertidal area, and extending approximately 200 meters landward of the high water mark.

Network contribution area scores were exported from the SciMAP application outputs within SAGA GIS. About this layer

Network contribution area scores were exported from the SciMAP application outputs within SAGA GIS. The scores were based on inputs from CEH Land cover 2007, Met Office average rainfall and 5 meter DTM. The High contribution category boundary was determined by selecting +1 standard deviation of the distribution of the scores.
